body: Releasing Tabsona to the Chrome Web Store: 1) bump version in apps/extension/manifest.json and both package.json, move CHANGELOG Unreleased into it; 2) task check; 3) task package then task cws:upload; 4) task screenshots and replace the 5 listing screenshots in the dashboard BEFORE submitting — agent-browser connect 9222 to the user's Chrome (remote debugging on), focus the remove button + Space, then confirm the Remove dialog for each; upload via a tagged Screenshots file input; Save draft; verify with a fresh load; 5) ask the user, then task cws:publish. Submitting locks the listing until review ends.
